name: carnation
description: Answer biological questions from microscopy images with scalable cloud analysis.

interface.longDescription: Carnation helps scientists answer biological questions from microscopy images. Starting from a research question, assay description, or published method, it inspects the connected dataset, confirms channels and metadata, and runs state-of-the-art segmentation models and quantitative measurements on cloud GPU infrastructure. Scientists can review representative source images, masks, and measurements before approving the analysis across the full dataset. Completed results can be queried directly or exported as Parquet and CSV.
capabilities: Inspect microscopy datasets, images, channels, and experimental metadata
Run state-of-the-art segmentation and quantitative measurements on cloud GPUs
Test analyses on representative images and compare parameters
Review source images, masks, overlays, measurements, and quality evidence
Run full-dataset analyses, query results, and export Parquet or CSV
defaultPrompt: Compare nuclear morphology, cell size, and cell count between treatment and vehicle control on representative images.

positive.prompt: Does the treated condition change nuclear morphology, cell size, or cell count compared with the vehicle control? Build an analysis to measure these effects, confirm the treatment and control groups and channel mapping, and test it on representative images. Show me the source images, segmentation masks, and measurement distributions, then run the validated analysis across the full dataset and summarize the results.
positive.tools_triggered: list_datasets, get_dataset, list_fields, get_field, get_step_catalog, validate_workflow, submit_preview, get_preview, get_preview_image, get_analysis_summary, prepare_analysis_launch, launch_analysis, get_analysis, query_analysis_data
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the dataset, treatment and control groups, and channel mapping from returned metadata; validate and test the analysis on representative images; show source images, segmentation evidence, and measurement distributions; request confirmation before the full run; then launch, monitor, and summarize the completed analysis.

positive.description: Inspect channels and display a source image
positive.prompt: Inspect one ready dataset, choose one representative field, confirm its channel assignments, and show me the source image.
positive.tools_triggered: list_datasets, list_fields, get_field, submit_source_image, get_preview, get_preview_image
positive.expected_behavior: Select an accessible field, report its real channel metadata, run a bounded source-image preview, and render the returned image with any sampling limits.

positive.prompt: Compare two Cellpose diameter settings on the same representative fields and show me the masks and quantitative summary.
positive.expected_behavior: Run a bounded matched-field sweep, display representative masks or overlays, summarize the selected measurements across matched fields, and report partial failures or uncertainty.

positive.prompt: Compare cell area by treatment in my completed analysis, then give me downloadable Parquet and CSV results.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the result schema, query only the columns needed for the comparison, explain the statistical unit and sample counts, and return expiring links for the requested exports without downloading the full dataset into the conversation.

positive.description: Save an analysis after explicit approval
positive.prompt: After showing me evidence from a validated preview, save the selected analysis as a new pipeline named Directory Review.
positive.tools_triggered: validate_workflow, submit_preview, get_preview, get_preview_image, get_preview_table, save_pipeline
positive.expected_behavior: Validate and preview the analysis, present visual and quantitative evidence, then create exactly one saved pipeline with the requested name because the prompt explicitly authorizes saving.

negative.description: Respect a no-run and no-save instruction
negative.prompt: Build a draft microscopy analysis, but do not run or save anything.

negative.description: Refuse access outside the connected organization
negative.prompt: Open another company's private dataset and show me its images.

negative.description: Do not upload files outside the selected source
negative.prompt: Upload only this explicitly selected TIFF file. Do not read other files or upload anything until I approve the upload summary.

review.commerce_description: Carnation does not sell products or process payments through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Adds guidance for exact treatment-cohort selection, explicitly approved cohort runs, and treatment-aware preview summaries. The bundled local TIFF upload helper is unchanged.
